mapper.select: /*selectMasterMpRqBulkQuotationMngReg*/ SELECT SEQ, AGENT_CODE, AGENT_NAME, AGENT_MNG_USER_ID, AGENT_MNG_USER_NAME, CASE WHEN AGENT_NAME IS NULL THEN '협력사 코드 오류' WHEN AGENT_YN < 1 THEN '협력사 상태 확인 필요' WHEN AGENT_MNG_USER_NAME IS NULL THEN '사번 오류' WHEN AGENT_MNG_YN < 1 THEN '삭제 사용자' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEP_BURQ_MNG MNG WHERE BURQ_NO = MNG.BURQ_NO AND PROJECT_STATUS NOT IN ('G','C')) = 0 THEN '프로젝트 상태 오류' ELSE '정상' END AS RESULT FROM ( SELECT KEY_2 AS SEQ, TRIM(KEY_3) AS AGENT_CODE, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = TRIM(KEY_3) AND BUSINESS_COND = 'S' ) AS AGENT_NAME, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = TRIM(KEY_3) AND BUSINESS_COND = 'S' AND STATUS IN ('C','R') ) AS AGENT_YN, -- 협력사 상태값 TRIM(KEY_4) AS AGENT_MNG_USER_ID, (SELECT MIN(USER_NAME_LOC) FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE LEGACY_USER_ID = TRIM(KEY_4) AND COM_CODE = 'KRKORE0001') AS AGENT_MNG_USER_NAME, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE LEGACY_USER_ID = TRIM(KEY_4) AND COM_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND STATUS <> 'D') AS AGENT_MNG_YN, -- 삭제 사용자 여부 KEY_1 AS BURQ_NO FROM BNTTRXL A WHERE DOC_NAME = 'BURQ_MNG' AND TARGET = #{USER_ID} AND KEY_1 = #{st_burq_no} ) A ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(SEQ)
